provenance_basis: Coordinator-recorded artifact lineage; exporter checks exact manifest binary paths and tags, not executable hashes.

profiles.healthy: One shared 500 Mbps link; 70 ms DOWN / 30 ms UP; no loss, jitter, QoS cut or blackhole.
profiles.independent: Three TCP carriers on one 200 Mbps link plus one QUIC on another 200 Mbps link; 70/30 ms; QUIC forward rate 10 Mbps nominally 15–25 s; UDP blackhole nominally 30–33 s. UP mirrors impairment.
profiles.loss-clear: QUIC, 500 Mbps, 70/30 ms; 20% DOWN loss clearing at first existing epoch at/after 20 s of the profile clock; no UP loss, jitter, QoS cut or blackhole.

method: Every raw bin is retained; bin i covers [i*interval,(i+1)*interval). No smoothing, trimming or bands.
Echo points use actual attempt start time and successful latency. Failed/unavailable records remain null; markers above the axis are outcomes, not latency values.
UP curves are sink-confirmation arrival; the probe can settle beyond offered load. Bins after the final observed confirmation are not manufactured.
Whole metrics are probe-provided; no new quantile aggregation is applied.
Nominal phase guides use probe time. Actual service samples and loss events retain separate clocks.
Default-policy comparison: prior 10%/10%, candidate 20%/20%. One finite observation does not establish causality or indefinite sustainability.
Capture names retain reproducible identity; host paths, endpoint addresses and free-form error text stay in the internal raw evidence.
